Repository evidence:
Section: What This Project Is

Tensor-Flow-Basics is a compact deep-learning learning repository organized around progressively richer TensorFlow/Keras exercises.

Basic Math Model,

Fashion Classifier,

CNN Number Recognition,

Horse or Human.

Section: Repository Structure

Visible notebooks include:

Basic Math Model/TF_starter.ipynb,

Fashion Classifier/TF_Fashion.ipynb,

CNN Number Recognition/Character_Recognition.ipynb,

Horse or Human/Horse_or_human.ipynb.

The notebooks are materially larger than their accompanying README notes.

The repository's technical evidence therefore comes primarily from executable notebooks.

Section: Basic TensorFlow Model Work

The Basic Math Model notebook is the starting experiment.

Its repository position and filename indicate a TensorFlow starter exercise.

Because the notebook is a large instructional notebook and no local README explains provenance, the corpus treats it as learning/exercise material rather than claiming every surrounding notebook cell as independently authored design.

Section: Fashion Classification

Fashion Classifier/TF_Fashion.ipynb is paired with a README that explicitly describes the model as a simple DNN.

This records a dense-neural-network image-classification stage before the convolutional examples.

The notebook environment makes it possible to inspect training behavior, predictions, and model outputs interactively.

Section: CNN Character/Number Recognition

CNN Number Recognition/Character_Recognition.ipynb contains a convolutional classification model.

Repository search evidence shows Keras layers including:

convolutional layers,

dense layers,

a final 10-unit softmax output.

The notebook also contains model.fit with validation data.

This is concrete training code, not a model architecture sketch.

Section: CNN Motivation

The local README states that this model improves on the DNN using convolutions.

It also explicitly proposes recurrent neural networks as a future extension for reading full sequences of numbers or alphanumeric content.

That later idea is documented as future direction.
